cognitive_capacity.rationale: All samples use numbers in the 1000-8000 range with rounding tasks targeting nearest 10, 100, or 1000. Complexity of place-value reasoning is appropriate for Grade 3 Quarter 1, with clear procedural steps reflected in consistent hint structures.

competency_alignment.rationale: Every sample directly instantiates the core competency of rounding to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand. Problems present unambiguous rounding directives without superfluous context, maintaining tight alignment to the written curriculum objective.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: All five decomposed requirements (round, numbers, nearest_ten, hundred, thousand) are demonstrated across the sample set. Coverage is comprehensive with dedicated samples for each rounding target, ensuring lossless mapping to the full competency.

decomposition.reasoning: The requirement list covers every semantic component: the verb (round), the object (numbers), and all three target precisions (nearest ten, nearest hundred, nearest thousand). No required element is missing and the decomposition adds no inauthentic constraints.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Sample set includes nine rounding-to-nearest-thousand cases, six rounding-to-nearest-hundred cases, and seven rounding-to-nearest-ten cases. Both up-rounding (digit >= 5) and down-rounding (digit < 5) scenarios are represented across targets.
